limitations: Percentages divide matched original calls/tokens by the full corpus denominator, not by proposals.
Proposal match percentage is descriptive precision, not deployment safety or task success.
Programs see prior/current observations; future calls are replay labels only.
Original recorded token counts are known; avoiding those calls is conditional on dispensable reasoning and successful program execution.
Gross estimates exclude routing/program/false-positive costs and future context/cache effects.
Per-program savings may overlap; combined totals deduplicate targets and exclude dependent adjacent substitutions.
New candidates use candidate-specific discovery/validation issue partitions; previously inspected discovery issues are excluded from validation. This corpus is not untouched external validation.
Coverage-only or EOF-equivalent scenarios are not added to exact totals.
No recorded commands are executed and no paid model calls occur.
